binaires.rsync:
#!/bin/sh
echo "rsync $* pass=$ELPIS_BACKUP_SSH_PASS force=$SSH_ASKPASS_REQUIRE" >> "$FAUX_JOURNAL"
case "$*" in *refus*) echo "Permission denied, please try again." >&2; exit 5;; esac
exit 0
binaires.ssh:
#!/bin/sh
echo "ssh $*" >> "$FAUX_JOURNAL"
case "$*" in *absent*) echo "ssh: connect to host absent port 22: Connection refused" >&2; exit 255;; esac
exit 0
